info.name: BiteSync Master API (Autonomous E2E - Phases 1, 2 & Sprint 3A)
info.description: Single-click, infinitely re-runnable Master E2E Postman Collection covering API Gateway, user-service (Auth, Refresh, Logout Blacklist, Multi-Role RBAC), and restaurant-service (MongoDB Onboarding, Ownership Isolation, ESR Composite Cursor Pagination, and Hybrid L1 Caffeine + L2 Redis + Pub/Sub Eviction).
